notes.title: The Power of 9: Janosik 2’s First Month
notes.content:
Hey Adventurers!

We hope you all had a chance to rest over the winter break and cranked the party meter up for New Year’s! Here’s to unforgettable gaming moments, epic adventures that would make Janosik himself proud, and a fantastic 2025.

As we reflect on the first month since [b]Janosik 2[/b] launched, one thing is clear - [b]the number 9 has been our lucky charm.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/308003a1630280d2d811346b934f316ce216c2a2.png[/img]
It all started with our release on December [b]9[/b]th. Since then, we’ve been thrilled to see a [b]9[/b]5% positive review score from players. The cherry on top? GameGrin’s Dylan Pamintuan surprised us with a glowing [b]9[/b].5/10 review - what a way to kick things off!

But the biggest "[b]9[/b]" came just before we wrapped 2024…

Just two days after launch, [b]Janosik 2[/b] was nominated for the [b]Indie of the Year Award[/b] on IndieDB, standing tall alongside [b]99[/b] other incredible indie games, including the Game of the Year nominee, [b]Balatro[/b].
We were beyond happy to be considered for the award so soon after launch, but when the final results came in, our excitement reached new heights:

[h3][b]Janosik 2 was crowned the 9th best indie game of 2024![/b][/h3]

Legends say Janosik’s strength came from his giant ancestry, but to find ourselves among the giants of the indie gaming world is an entirely different kind of achievement.

A huge thank you to everyone who voted for us in the Indie of the Year Awards. We wouldn’t be here without you. Let’s make 2025 the year of legendary Highlander adventures with [b]Janosik 2[/b]!

notes.title: Janosik 2 is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
[h3][b]The Wait is Over: Janosik 2 is Here![/b][/h3]
After three years of hard work [b]Janosik 2[/b] has officially launched! As the developer, I’m filled with a mix of excitement, anticipation, and a touch of anxiety. This game has been such a huge part of my life, and I can’t wait to see what you think about this next chapter in Janosik’s adventures. My goal has always been to make this sequel bigger, better, and even more immersive than the original [b]Janosik[/b].

[previewyoutube=KHsiIeIlNLo;full][/previewyoutube]

So, you're probably wondering what will you find in [b]Janosik 2[/b]... Well, obviously, there is a brand-new adventure, featuring werewolves, vampires, and a mission for Janosik to rescue Janka - his girlfriend. From there, the journey takes some unexpected twists. I've created 50 levels packed with deadly enemies and thrilling challenges to keep you on your toes.

If you played the first game, you’ll bump into some familiar faces, like the witch and Jan the Inventor, but there’s so much new to discover: new NPCs, deadlier enemies, helpful merchants, and...new playable characters!

That's right - Janosik won't face this adventure alone. He will be joined by three new playable characters: Bogdan, Janka, and Hugo. Each of them brings unique abilities that will alter the way you approach the game. I've also prepared a wide range of upgrades to go along with new characters - from weapons and movement abilities to special powers like freezing or electrifying enemies.

Today, the world of [b]Janosik 2[/b] is ready for you to explore. I can’t wait to see how you tackle its challenges, uncover its secrets, and interact with all the characters. Here’s to a journey full of excitement, surprises, and most importantly - fun!

Jump in, and make [b]Janosik 2[/b] an adventure to remember!

[h3][b]Get Janosik 2 now:[/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1640400/Janosik_2/

- Marcin "Onix" Onysko

notes.title: New Dungeons for Janosik Today! Janosik 2 Coming Dec 9th!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We've got a double dose of exciting news for you today! We've prepared a major update for Janosik with brand new content and features. On top of that, we're finally ready to let you all know when you will be able to embark on the next adventure in[b] Janosik 2[/b].

[h3][b]Janosik 2 is  launching on [b]December 9, 2024[/b]![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38704363/267e8c2de4bd49602b6ca37b7d2c50266a2eebc6.png[/img]

The legend of the Slovakian Highlander continues.

The adventure picks up right after the events of [b]Janosik[/b]! Tricked by an ingenious ruse, Janosik must find a way to escape captivity and take the fight directly to Countess Bathory, who thinks she is pulling all the strings in the Highlands. Joined by Bogdan the Werewolf and Hugo the Vampire, and Janka the Plucky Maiden traverse through massive levels filled with mythical foes, deadly traps, and pesky De Blonde's goons.

With four unique playable characters, lightning-fast action, and a bigger world to explore, [b]Janosik 2[/b] is a bigger, bolder adventure you don’t want to miss. 

[h3][b]Wishlist now:[/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1640400/Janosik_2/

[h3][b]Major Update for Janosik[/b][/h3]
You shouldn't show up at the release party in regular Janosik's slacks... It's a costume party, and we've got you covered!

To make sure you can dress for the occasion, and show off your heroic flair, we're introducing [b]4 new outfits for Janosik[/b], which you can unlock by completing brand new dungeons. 

To begin your quest for the stylish threads, you'll need to head through a newly added corridor that connects to the main hallway. Once inside, you'll find a room with outfit racks and four doors leading to different dungeons.

[b]Each dungeon contains 4 parts of a single outfit[/b] - a hat, a chest piece, trousers, and boots , once you collect them all, you can equip a stunning new look:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38704363/3a05b4a6641b382cc26a56313235fe05a665fd81.png[/img]
[list][*] [b]Robin Hood[/b]: A green outfit inspired by the legendary outlaw, perfect for a highlander known for stealing from the rich to give to the poor.
[*] [b]Knight[/b]: Gleaming silver armor that reflects the valor and strength of a true hero, who isn't afraid of any challenge.
[*] [b]Warlock Guy[/b]: Inspired by the Project Warlock series, a dark ensemble that channels the power of forbidden magic.
[*] [b]Musketeer[/b]: A bold yellow outfit that captures the flair and swashbuckling spirit of a daring adventurer.[/list]Prepare for [b]Janosik 2[/b] by diving into this update! With new dungeons to explore and stylish outfits to collect, this is the perfect time to warm up and rediscover the thrill of adventure. These challenges will test your mettle and reward you with treasures worthy of a true highlander.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38704363/bb94119a4649b14ddfc9d310628a35154b59fcf2.jpg[/img]

The Highlands are full of danger, but we're sure you have what it takes to overcome challenges ahead of you!

notes.title: Janosik 2 at Steam Next Fest 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38704363/6821d6e3f8b8daf3c1db07c9501a6e86a945475d.png[/img]

Hey, everyone!

We’re proud to let you all know that Janosik 2 is a part of the Steam Next Fest June 2024! Here’s a short info on what to expect from the traditional shepherd’s hat-wearing brave who joins forces with a reluctant vampire and burly werewolf to conquer evil minions of nefarious Countess Bathory and her fairy tale minions. 

Janosik 2 picks right after the events of the first game, and its story starts with, let's call it: "a date which went terribly wrong". [b]In the updated demo you can check out the first 3 out of 24 maps of Janosik 2 and get a taste of what’s ahead![/b]

Let’s step into this mythic pixel art land of the Slavic Highlander and see what challenges, threats, and enemies you can expect in the sequel.

[h3][b]Old-school precision platforming[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/3b820ca9c57ece73555251595605d644e4e9b59b.gif[/img]

Janosik 2 will require good management of your speed, momentum, and jumping distance, as well as good reaction time. A single mistake can lead to falling into a trap or not reaching a desired spot. A lot of platforming elements are in constant motion so it adds another layer of complexity to traversing the levels. 

The encounters in Janosik 2 are varied and require a good deal of bold moves and quick decision-making. You will frequently need to show your platforming prowess to collect shiny treasures and liberate imprisoned companions. You’ll need to keep your eyes peeled at all times because the danger can come from every direction. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/c4e40560d5ce89990d1de15f47b31bfe4a974379.gif[/img]

To make the challenge of Janosik 2 more manageable, we've added a lot of save points throughout the levels to make the backtracking easier.

During your journey, you will find golden coins, pricy jewels, and hefty treasures scattered around the landscapes. Make sure to fill your gold sack with coins, as some vendors have put a price on their prized possessions such as a throwable Shepherd’s Axe, a Bow, a Shield, or an heirloom that lets you freeze your foes in air. Gold can also help you reach some parts of the levels by unlocking passages when interacting with NPCs or fairy tale wonders like a wishing well. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/6a14aaa0b5e70763cd4d29cce5dc67883b5e5e2a.gif[/img]

Janosik 2 will let you explore the beautiful Slavic landscapes in their fullness as some parts of the world are interconnected by doors and passages, closed when approached for the first time. You’ll need to keep playing to see how deep the rabbit hole goes.

[h3][b]Threats on your way[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/de13be1bec522aed490c5c39d4ba284cc10bb807.gif[/img]

During your adventure, you will face not-so-friendly dogs wandering around, rats lurking in the underground tunnels, nasty fish with sharp teeth hunting underwater, venomous spiders in dungeons and caves, and more. You will also fight many human enemies like the soldiers of the nefarious Countess Bathory, and her sidekick, de Blonde.

In addition to “living” foes, there are also plenty of traps and deadly spots along the way. You’ll need to keep an eye out on all sorts of spikes coming from walls, ceilings, and floors, huge boulders dropping from the ceiling while you rush through corridors, fireball-spitting gargoyles, the shaky and crumbling floor, disappearing platforms, or spider webs that will slow you down a bunch. not to mention that, sometimes, the floor obviously is lava ;) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/5ce6211aa1d16f6c27bc3461d5916e74170588ee.gif[/img]

Underwater exploration will not be easy, as you will encounter various obstacles, menacing creatures, and need to manage the oxygen supply. Collect air bubbles floating nearby to make sure you can reach the surface safely or take a risk diving deeper to grab precious trinkets. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/23ad9876ec3cd9720ba4bbb055155dd916e5b166.gif[/img]

Of course, sometimes you can take it slow and beat some parts of the levels carefully. On the other hand, many sequences combining enemies and obstacles will require constant movement. But you will learn all that soon enough.

We’re planning a Janosik-packed summer this year, so wishlist and follow the game to stay up to date with all the news. We have a lot of awesome stuff to share in the coming weeks, starting with a Next Fest Demo!

On that note, we’d like to wish you a happy Steam Next Fest, as it is truly a time like no other. There are so many wonderful demos to check out, and we hope Janosik 2 will be on your list of demos to play. 

[b]Enjoy, and see you next time![/b]

[h3][b]Wishlist Janosik 2 Now![/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1640400/Janosik_2/

notes.title: Big Update: new level, skills, enemies, and more!
notes.content:
Janosik is a passion project of a single developer who managed to turn his idea into a successful indie game [b]played by almost 400,000 people[/b] on various platforms so far. 

As Marcin (Onix) keeps working on Janosik 2, he also keeps growing as a game designer and programmer. With these new skills, he decided to [b]remaster the original game[/b] as his way of thanking all of you for playing Janosik and supporting him with kind words.

With this update, [b]Janosik - Highlander Precision Platformer[/b] now works on the latest version of the Construct 3 engine, which enabled us to solve some past technical issues and add new features that are bringing the game closer to the sequel that’s currently in production.

The updated version of Janosik is [b]available in English and Polish on Windows, Mac, and Linux[/b]. In the coming weeks, we plan to bring back the Slovak localization as well as introduce completely [b]new translations to Russian, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, and Simplified Chinese,[/b] so stayed tuned! 

Also, please note that after this update, [b]your previously saved data will no longer be compatible with the new version[/b]. However, you can still access the previous version of the game and your saved progress by switching to the new "legacy_version" beta branch.

Check out below for all the new things added to the game:

A map - you can see where you are now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38704363/c50c7ced81c94e7fffa10d3b286aa5184a0ecc39.png[/img]

A passage that connects levels, so you can travel fast between them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38704363/6f3143d4a7ec312e8153a75b598e23dc42a5a77d.png[/img]

New NPC: Master Toro. He sells sword upgrades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38704363/6071bb7b25b31bc6adcb2ff213744a047d8eae52.png[/img]

The witch house is redesigned. She has a cat now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38704363/46a5821bcb057a390293ebdf271e6dbcdbdd1c45.png[/img]

Most of the levels are re-designed. For instance, in the very first tutorial level, you can now find a well…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38704363/dd848ad07f1972bc0957e7633ff2b8d222c04276.png[/img]

New enemies: bird, monk, blue spider, big fish, frog head.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38704363/fe1ca32010e8024778e1f3e291580125a8983633.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38704363/b11739b8257d3783c055dad93aaa417749d72401.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38704363/0c81d17e8b6c13954f7afec8521211ae7083785d.gif[/img]

We’ve added lava. It’s very hot and deadly!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38704363/f3b41a8509771a4b1660c5b16e0ee82fb577b269.gif[/img]

New level: The Castle. That’s where Count Von Żur lives.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38704363/9e86d813520d82b0d5de2324cb4a0cae143159ba.png[/img]

Bosses updates: added new animations and new attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38704363/6e2d753ce320691f4fdfa9cb930e34356ed9ddb0.png[/img]

Many people asked what a dragon is doing in the game. So we’ve added a story about a dragon and a flooded dungeon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38704363/3346a9b5563c789d5bcc2ab997371e6ea1b326c5.png[/img]

The game has an updated skills system. It’s now more similar to what you’ll see in Janosik 2. For example, Janosik can swim from the beginning of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38704363/adcd0f4026d77312637211cb306927a1d497d9e3.gif[/img]

There’s also a new skill to unlock - ax throw.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38704363/d3ebe9ceeaa7f2a216e93191ea38e60dcb2b7e0c.gif[/img]

The health system is slightly updated. 

Janosik has 3 base lives (hearts). You can find more lives (hearts) in the game (maximum 8 hearts). If you die, you’ll respawn only with 3 base lives again.

If you like the game, we’d appreciate it if you could share it with your friends and leave a Steam review. Also, be sure to wishlist Janosik 2!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1640400/Janosik_2/

notes.title: Janosik 2 Live Dev part 7
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

If you think Janosik was a blast, just you wait till you see what Janosik 2 is all about. (Janosik's vampire and werewolf buddies amongst other things it would seem).
